name: sakurascore-simulation
description: SakuraScore India — sakura-abm audience simulation engine, TypeScript port running on Bun + dot-matrix dashboard

scripts.parity:regen: python3 -c "import json,random,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from sakurascore_sim.adapters.abm_engine import build_barabasi_albert;r=random.Random(42);mt={'random8':[r.random() for _ in range(8)]};r2=random.Random(42);mt['randrange6_n30']=[r2.randrange(30) for _ in range(6)];r3=random.Random(42);mt['randrange_n13']=[r3.randrange(13) for _ in range(4)];g=random.Random(42);mt['ba40m3_adj']=build_barabasi_albert(40,3,g);json.dump(mt,open('tests/fixtures/mt_reference.json','w'),indent=1);from sakurascore_sim.simulation.runner import run_simulation_from_file;json.dump(run_simulation_from_file('configs/example_experiment.json'),open('tests/fixtures/python_output.json','w'),indent=1)"
